Every feature is well thought-out!

Every Feature Tuned for Connection

Designed without bloat. Zero cryptocurrency systems, zero vote-locked perks, just butter-smooth timekeeping for your members. We love to see communities thrive, and we want to help you keep your members connected across timezones.

🌍

260+ Countries & Intelligent Offsets

Full support for daylight saving transitions. If you query countries with multiple zones like the US, Canada, or Australia, Clock Bot advises users on specific regional identifiers.

/time country [country]
👤

Opt-in Member Profiles

Link your local timezone once with /timezone set. Anyone in the server can type /time user @Alex to check whether you're working or sound asleep.

/time user [user]
🎂

Automated Daily Birthdays

Runs daily at 8:00 AM UTC in your designated channel. Automatically calculates turning age, celebrates with warm golden embeds, and handles Feb 29 leap years seamlessly.

/birthday setup [channel]
🔄

Frictionless Time Conversion

Instantly convert times between two nations. Displays side-by-side local times, time differences (e.g. "Tokyo is 9h ahead"), and day shift indicators (➕ Next day / ➖ Previous day).

/time conversion [from] [time] [to]
🏆

Server Tenure Milestones

Celebrate community loyalty with /time_spent. Calculates member presence down to precise days, hours, and minutes with join date cards.

/time_spent [user]
🔔

Stealth Timer Reminders

Set quiet countdown reminders from seconds to hours. Messages remain hidden until duration expires, keeping server text channels free of clutter.

/reminder [user] [time] [unit]
Full Discord API Integration

Slash Command Directory

Click any command syntax to copy directly to your clipboard.

/time country [country]
Copy

Fetches live local time in any country, displaying formatted date, UTC offset, day period, and relative Discord timestamp.

/time user [user]
Copy

Inspects the local time of a linked community member. Avoids 3 AM wake-up pings.

/time conversion [from] [time] [to]
Copy

Converts time between two countries, calculating day-shifts and hour differences automatically.

/timezone set [timezone]
Copy

Links your Discord profile to a standard IANA timezone database name (e.g., Asia/Tokyo). Ephemeral & private.

/timezone remove
Copy

Deletes your saved timezone profile from the bot registry instantly.

/birthday set [day] [month] [year?]
Copy

Saves your birthdate for annual server celebrations. Birth year is optional for age calculations.

/birthday setup [channel]
Manage Server

Configures the Discord text channel where daily 8:00 AM UTC birthday announcements are broadcast.

/birthday remove
Copy

Removes your birthday record from all server announcement loops.

/day [day] [month] [year]
Copy

Discovers what day of the week any historical or future date falls on.

/time_spent [user?]
Copy

Reveals total duration spent in the server (e.g., 420 days, 14 hours, and 12 minutes).

/reminder [user] [time] [unit] [msg]
Copy

Discreet timer-based reminder. Admins can schedule reminders for other members.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Members voluntarily link their timezone using /timezone set [timezone]. Once saved, anyone in the server can use /time user @Alex to check their current local time before messaging.
Announcements fire daily at 08:00 AM UTC across all guilds that have configured a channel with /birthday setup. If a member included their birth year, the embed calculates their turning age.
Clock Bot is programmed with leap-year awareness. During non-leap years, it celebrates February 29 birthdays on February 28, ensuring nobody ever misses their celebration!
Nations like the United States, Russia, Canada, Brazil, and Australia cover multiple time zones. The bot displays the primary financial capital by default and suggests specific regions (like America/Los_Angeles or America/Chicago).
Yes! Standard members can only set reminders for themselves to prevent notification spam. Server administrators with Manage Server or Administrator privileges can ping other members when setting reminders.
